summary: Explored Unity/codex web-extension patterns and pi-coding-agent 0.84.4's registerProvider API to confirm contracts, then scaffolded the ollama extension: wrote a typed HTTP client plus tests for list/show/pull/delete. Two test failures (DELETE init shape, pull error line without trailing newline) were fixed by correcting the test assertion and flushing the NDJSON buffer after the read loop.
decisions: Static inspector tab receives full AgentStore + projectPath; chosen as the UI surface for the model management panel.
ProviderConfig supports models[] with {name, maxContextLength, capabilities, baseUrl, apiKey}; will set capabilities via show() capabilities.
Settings surface: host URL field only; other Ollama knobs go through the inspector management UI.
statusBar surface skipped for v1 because static functions can't poll; relies on inspector panel for live status.
Vitest config uses jsdom + testing-library; no .prettierrc found, so prettier defaults (2-space, double quotes) apply.
Branch feat/ollama-extension created for the scaffolded work.
NDJSON streaming must flush the final buffered line after the read loop even if it lacks a trailing newline.
errors: DELETE test asserted init.json undefined because the client spreads rest and assigns body; fixed by parsing init.body instead.
Pull error path: error JSON chunk with no trailing newline sat unprocessed in the buffer; fixed by emitting remaining buffered line after the read loop.
Filesystem note: Windows path C:/Users/mchan/.gizmo/registries/gizmo-registry — the registry lives outside the projects/gizmo monorepo.
